# MemQ Protocol Skill

This package provides the `SKILL.md` configuration for the Multinex MemQ Protocol.

## Capabilities
- Teaches the AI how to use the MemQ MCP server tools (`mcp_memq_query_memory`, `mcp_memq_add_memory`, `mcp_memq_reflect_memory`).
- Enforces a "Wake Up" routine to pull historical context before acting.
- Enforces a "Sleep" routine to consolidate working memory into durable long-term storage.

## Usage
Inject `SKILL.md` into your LLM's system prompt. The agent will require access to the Multinex `memq` MCP server tools to fulfill the protocol.
